Milk
The Milk list groups milks and yogurts based on the amount of fat they have (fat-free/low fat, reduced fat, and whole). Cheeses are found on the Meat 
and Meat Substitutes list and cream and other dairy fats are found on the Fats list.
Note: In general, one milk choice is 1 cup (8 fluid ounces or ½ pint) milk or yogurt.
